title: I made a free browser RTS that runs from the Prehistoric Age to the Interstellar Age: Hierarch
author: YasuoMain528
selftext:
Surgeon and AI hobbyist here. I built a new game called [Hierarch](https://hierarch.zeno-ai-games.com), a real-time strategy game that takes your realm through 18 ages, from the Prehistoric to the Interstellar Age. It is free and has live PvP multiplayer with voice chat. 

What you do: gather, build, research, and fight. Armies develop over the epochs and later ages bring aircraft, mechs, and strategic weapons including nuclear warheads. 

Game Modes (how you win):

* Conquest: destroy every rival realm
* Wonder: build a Wonder and hold it until the timer runs out
* Assassination: keep your leader alive and end theirs
* Final Epic: be first to reach the last age
* King of the Hill: hold the circle at the center of the map
* Domination: claim every flag on the map

Single player against CPU opponents or online lobbies with friends. You choose the start age and end age, map type and size, water distribution, starting resources, and game speed.

Play it here: [https://hierarch.zeno-ai-games.com](https://hierarch.zeno-ai-games.com/)

It is built by a small studio with Claude Code. Feedback of any kind is welcome, especially on balance and on how the CPU plays.
